svg.text: Curvature-regularized MBRL — spectral reward architecture (closed-form path, spectral.enabled)
src/mbrl: models/{encoder,dynamics,spectral,policy}.py, training/loop.py, regularization/{hutchinson,schedule}.py — recipe of bridge runs 2–3 (claims_ledger.md)
Environment
Pendulum / MuJoCo
(obs, a, r, obs′) → replay
Encoder (+ EMA copy)
z = LayerNorm(MLP(obs)) ∈ ℝᵏ
k ≤ 4·obs_dim (latent cap v2)
targets: z′ = EMA-encoder(obs′)
Affine latent dynamics
ẑ′ = z + f(z) + G(z)·a
L_dyn = ‖ẑ′ − z′_EMA‖²
Spectral reward stack — closed form, no Hutchinson on R, no Adam (models/spectral.py)
Rolling cache (FIFO, 4096)
x = [ z.detach(), a (, τ) ] — penalty coords
y = symlog(r)
refit when |cache| ≥ M, then every refit_every updates
Random Fourier features — σ ladder
φⱼ(x) = √(2/M) cos(wⱼ·x + bⱼ)
wⱼ ~ 𝒩(0, σ²₍ₖ₎ I), bⱼ ~ U[0, 2π)
σ over the transform: block k of M/K features at σₖ,
σ = [0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0] → separated frequency bands
λ-polynomial band weights (per-degree schedule shifts)
θⱼ(t) = Σ_d c_d · λ(t + s_d) · |wⱼ|^(2·deg_d)
run-3 shape “high-clamp”: deg = [1, 3], c = [0.1, 10]
— spare low-σ blocks, suppress high-σ blocks
λ(t): cuberoot / sin² chirp / sincos (commensurate f₂ = m·f₁), floor > 0
Closed-form weighted ridge (one (M,M) solve / head)
ĉ = (ΦᵀΦ + diag(θ(t)) + εI)⁻¹ Φᵀ y
ensemble: 3 heads, independent W draws; R(x) = Σⱼ ĉⱼ φⱼ(x)
Exact curvature penalty (diagonal in frequency space — replaces Hutchinson on R)
E‖∇²R‖²_F = E(ΔR)² = (1/M) Σⱼ ĉⱼ² |wⱼ|⁴
cross terms vanish over phases (rank-1 feature Hessians ⇒ ‖wwᵀ‖²_F = (tr wwᵀ)²) — the null-Lagrangian
equivalence holds exactly-in-expectation; value feeds auto-dose + the adaptive horizon certificate
z (detached), a, symlog(r)
Stochastic penalty path (MLP reward / optional dynamics)
Hutchinson Frobenius: E_v ‖∇²R·v‖², v ~ Rademacher (2 probes)
clamped Lap-2 trace: max( (v₁ᵀHv₁)(v₂ᵀHv₂), 0 )
non-negativity is the operative property (+41 vs −40 vs −79, report §3);
fp32 under bf16 autocast; probe RNG checkpointed (bitwise resume)
total: L = L_dyn + L_rew(MLP only) + λ(t)·penalty
spectral path: penalty on R is EXACT inside the refit; only the optional
dynamics term stays stochastic. Never penalize the policy Hessian (R16).
Behaviour learning — imagined rollouts (Dreamer-style)
r̂ = symexp( clamp( R([z, π(z)]), ±m·B ) ) (data-driven bound B)
z_{t+1} = dyn(z_t, π(z_t)), t = 0 … H
policy ↑ G^λ + entropy; value ↓ ‖V − G^λ‖² (return-normalized)
adaptive horizon: H grows only as the penalty EMA certifies low curvature
(H ≤ 25) — long horizons are PURCHASED by curvature control (R15)
R(x), exact penalty
π acts in the environment
Bridge experiments (supervised proxy; scripts/bridge_experiment.py) — wide cut + sharp transverse cut
Gram (sharp) cut: mean_n (ΔR(x_n))² = cᵀG c, G = DᵀD/N, D = −(Φ ⊙ |w|²) (PSD; exact pointwise curvature density)
hybrid penalty: P = λ·[ α·diag(θ) + (1−α)·M·G ] — scale-matched: E[M·G] = diag(|w|⁴)
run 1: positivity alone NOT SUPPORTED 0/9 (data-null directions). run 2: hybrid 7/9, benefit tracks Frobenius angle ∠(diag, G) ≈ 65–79°, ρ_Spearman = +0.63.
run 3: σ-ladder × λ-polynomial = +33.7% (10/10), + Gram = +36.8% — the INTERACTION carries it. Ported: spectral.sigma_w accepts a list; preset experiment/spectral_ladder.
conjecture tier — Weil-positivity identification untested here; supervised +33.7% is not yet an RL claim (validation arm pending).
Symbols
M = n_features (512) · K = ladder rungs · θ(t) = per-feature ridge weights · λ(t) = penalty schedule · symlog(r) = sign(r)·log(1+|r|) · symexp = inverse
Φ ∈ ℝ^{N×M} feature matrix · H = ∇²R in latent coords (z, a, τ) · γ = discount · λ_r = return mixing · ε = 10⁻⁸ ridge floor · τ = task one-hot (multitask)
Closed-form chain: σ ladder fixes the bands → θ(t) doses them through training → one linear solve per refit → exact penalty certifies the imagination horizon.
